title: We are here, on the frontline of equality / against hate
slide_intent: Pair a broad value with an action or gesture people can recognize. Repetition lets the two sentiments be read together.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can express solidarity across distinct photographs through a consistent declaration and boxed type.
demonstration: A two-person portrait carries the equality line. A photograph of hands forming a heart carries the statement against hate.
practical_value: Pair photographs whose pose or gesture can remain readable alongside the headline and check the crop at its intended size.

content_islands.name: Equality panel
content_islands.spec: Fill the left half with the two people side by side. Set the green-on-black text below their faces.

content_islands.name: Against hate panel
content_islands.spec: Place the heart gesture high on the right. Use a pink text field below the hands so the gesture remains intact.
